tasks.label: Build All Native Components
tasks.command: export JAVA_HOME=$(jenv prefix zulu64-25.0.3 || jenv prefix 25) && export JAVA8_HOME=$(jenv prefix 1.8) && export CACIO_JAVA_HOME=$JAVA_HOME && export FRENCHPRESS_JAVA_HOME=$JAVA_HOME && ./scripts/build-gl4es-android.sh && ./scripts/build-openal-android.sh && ./scripts/build-lwjgl3-android.sh && ./scripts/build-cacio-android.sh && ./scripts/build-frenchpress-android.sh

tasks.label: Assemble Debug APK
tasks.command: export JAVA_HOME=$(jenv prefix zulu64-25.0.3 || jenv prefix 25) && cd launcher && ./gradlew :app:assembleDebug

tasks.label: Assemble Release APK
tasks.command: export JAVA_HOME=$(jenv prefix zulu64-25.0.3 || jenv prefix 25) && cd launcher && ./gradlew :app:assembleRelease

tasks.label: Build All (Natives + Assets + APK)
tasks.command: export JAVA_HOME=$(jenv prefix zulu64-25.0.3 || jenv prefix 25) && export JAVA8_HOME=$(jenv prefix 1.8) && export CACIO_JAVA_HOME=$JAVA_HOME && export FRENCHPRESS_JAVA_HOME=$JAVA_HOME && ./scripts/build-gl4es-android.sh && ./scripts/build-openal-android.sh && ./scripts/build-lwjgl3-android.sh && ./scripts/build-cacio-android.sh && ./scripts/build-frenchpress-android.sh && ./scripts/stage-launcher-assets.sh && cd launcher && ./gradlew :app:assembleDebug

tasks.label: Install Debug APK
tasks.command: export JAVA_HOME=$(jenv prefix zulu64-25.0.3 || jenv prefix 25) && cd launcher && ./gradlew :app:installDebug

tasks.label: Install and Run App
tasks.command: export JAVA_HOME=$(jenv prefix zulu64-25.0.3 || jenv prefix 25) && cd launcher && ./gradlew :app:installDebug && adb shell am start -n com.skarm.launcher/com.skarm.launcher.LauncherActivity
